description: JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line; every message agentd writes has "jsonrpc":"2.0". Property names are Go field names. All properties are optional on input; on output every property is present unless its type marks it omitempty in Go, and nil pointers, slices, and maps are null. Raw properties carrying native messages are removed unless initialize set IncludeRaw. Methods without a result reply with an empty object. Requests run concurrently, except that requests after initialize wait for it and requests naming the same session run in arrival order, apart from request/respond, request/cancel, session/interrupt, session/interruptTurn, and session/close. String types list their known constants as examples; "" means unset, and providers may report other values.

codes.-32800: cancelled by the client's $/cancelRequest (ErrorInfo.Kind is cancelled)

errors.description: Failed requests get a JSON-RPC error {code, message, data}, where data is an ErrorInfo. A line that is not JSON gets a -32700 error with a null id.
